items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: The interviewee narrates that 'Jack learned to play it... He later ran into Mel'. The interviewee (Edwin Ashcraft) is not the subject of the action 'ran into'; Jack is. The interviewee merely reports this event.

ctx.x: Yeah, as an office boy. In the corner of Adams and LaSalle, the old building's still up there. On armistice night, or rather on fake armistice night, if you remember, that came a week early, he and the other office boy got good and plastered. And they bought, each of them bought from Land and Healy's a C. Melody Saxe vault, which were then in Vogue and all over the windows of Land and Healy. And the other office boy thought better of it the next day and took his back, and Pettis didn't. Well, after the war was…
You mean Pettis? Pettis. I'm sorry. Oh, I didn't remember whether you meant Schoble or not.
